agents.name: cash-forecaster
agents.purpose: Produce a rolling 13-week cash forecast from canonical ledger entries plus forward-looking pipeline state. Read-only — never writes to the ledger or to external accounting systems.

agents.name: billing-reconciler
agents.purpose: Reconcile canonical subscription state against the external billing system nightly. Produces a reconciliation proposal for human review. Never writes back to the external billing system.

agents.name: deploy-watchdog
agents.purpose: Detect production deploy failures within 90 seconds and notify the deployment sub-cognition. Escalates to the platform-lead after three consecutive failures.

agents.name: identity-drift-detector
agents.purpose: Compare canonical identity state against the external IdP every hour and emit a typed drift event when divergence is detected.

agents.name: growth-experiment-runner
agents.purpose: Score active acquisition experiments daily on the channel-mix model and recommend allocation shifts. Recommendations are human-gated — the agent never moves spend on its own.

agents.name: ceo-strategist
agents.purpose: Generate the weekly executive brief from the three domain roll-ups (finance, product-operations, sales-marketing). Flag drift against approved OKRs. Human-gated; the brief is reviewed before it lands in the leadership team's surface.

agents.name: finance-ops-roll-up
agents.purpose: Aggregate the finance-ops domain's state (ledger summary, workforce state, compliance state) into the finance-rollup payload consumed by the CEO cognition node.

agents.name: product-ops-roll-up
agents.purpose: Aggregate product-operations domain state (delivery throughput, platform state, security posture) into the product-rollup payload consumed by the CEO cognition node.

agents.name: gtm-roll-up
agents.purpose: Aggregate sales-marketing domain state (pipeline state, customer health, growth state) into the gtm-rollup payload consumed by the CEO cognition node.
